mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expenses ( user_sub, type, title, amount, currency, status, vendor_name, receipt_date, vat_amount, receipt_file_url, ai_extracted_data, ai_flags, trip_from, trip_to, country_code, per_diem_rate, per_diem_days, distance_km, rate_per_km, created_by ) VALUES ( #{userSub}, #{type}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{currency}, 'DRAFT', #{vendorName}, #{receiptDate}, #{vatAmount}, #{receiptFileUrl}, #{aiExtractedData}, #{aiFlags}, #{tripFrom}, #{tripTo}, #{countryCode}, #{perDiemRate}, #{perDiemDays}, #{distanceKm}, #{ratePerKm}, #{userSub} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM expenses WHERE user_sub = #{userSub} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE expenses SET status = #{status}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE expenses SET status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, rejection_reason = #{rejectionReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM expenses WHERE status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY submitted_at ASC
SELECT * FROM expenses WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'PAID') AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC
SELECT * FROM expenses WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY reviewed_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE expenses SET status = 'PAID', paid_at = NOW(), retention_expires_at = DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 10 YEAR) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED'
